get.description: Each message carries `id` (the outbox sequence), `event` (the event type) and JSON `data`. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `?last_event_id=`) to replay up to 7 days of missed events. A connection without one starts with `ready` (its `id` is the current sequence). When the given id is newer than any event or older than what is kept, `resync` (also carrying the current sequence as `id`) tells the client to reload everything over REST. `parcel.live_position` messages carry the courier's position while en route; they have no `id` and are never replayed.
